Db.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing elder villager with readable face, big expressive eyes, white hair/beard silhouette and a warm green/brown palette that sits in the key art's cozy village; sides are visually indistinguishable, and the finish leans slightly more animated-film than stylised realism.

Ng.bar_b_note: A's braced timber frame, stone footing and cap read as a built wall but it is still a thin lone panel with flat cream infill, and B's blown-out white card with no cap or footing looks like a placeholder; the flat painted-backdrop mountains and even grass carpet keep both below Palworld base-building finish.

Sj.bar_b_note: The rock-plated boar has a strong grounded silhouette, real plate and fur detail and clearly out-scales the trainer, but A's faint-end frame crushes to near-solid black and B's orange-red magma glow between plates and reddened tusks drift the ground creature toward fire-type language and lose the white-tusk read.

Uo.bar_b_note: The village approach by day and night is warm and readable with lit windows, but the nave interior is a warm-graded yet sparse box with a bare plank floor, no haze or light shafts and a cool arched doorway at the far end, and B's diagonal timber posts slash across the near field of every nave frame.

Nl.bar_b_note: Standing Stormcapra matches the owner style bar (white fleece, dark legs, curled horns, blue accent, taller than the trainer), but A's faint frames twist into a hard-to-read upturned tangle and B's faint frames stretch the horns into long black tubes lying on the floor with the legs swallowed by the fleece.

Kr.bar_b_note: B's side alcoves gain benches, tables and glowing hearths that start to make the nave lived-in while A is a near-empty floor with a runner, but in both the dark stone pillar masses fill the frame edges, the far ends are purple doors rather than a warm focal point, and there is no atmospheric haze or shafting.

Yi.bar_b_note: B's blue runner leading to a warm glowing altar and a lit hearth in the reverse view gives the shrine end a real focal point, whereas A's cold blue-white fountain on an over-bright cobbled floor reads as a courtyard, but both have blown-out day walls and floors, evenly scattered pedestals and candle stands, and no Valheim-class haze or light shafts.

top_changes.change: Furnish and light the Crossing Hall as a great hall: long tables, benches, hearth and hanging props filling the empty plank and cobble floor, a warm glowing shrine/altar at the end of the runner (as in Yi B), warm volumetric haze and window light shafts, and exposure pulled down so day walls and floors stop blowing out.

Re-place the fixed hall cameras (or remove or thin the near-field geometry) so stone pillar masses and diagonal timber posts no longer fill frame edges or cross the view, framing the trainer and the nave's depth instead.

Fix creature faint poses and materials: skin weights on Stormcapra horns and legs so faint frames do not stretch or swallow them, a grounded readable faint pose, and lift the crushed-black faint-end shading on the rock boar while keeping its white tusks and ground palette.
